identity.statement: Software is an instrument. Every language, schema and abstraction is chosen for its measurable contribution to an objective — never by habit or taste.

principles.title: Instrumental rationality
principles.body: Means are evaluated against ends. What does not move the objective is removed.

principles.title: Engineering before ornament
principles.body: Specify, measure, then build. Form is a consequence of constraints.

principles.title: Data as ground truth
principles.body: Decisions are traced back to data. A model is only as reliable as its inputs.

principles.title: Flat control flow
principles.body: Many small functions, at most two levels of nesting, explicit contracts between them.

timeline.title: Dual-thread execution
timeline.subtitle: Two concurrent processes sharing one clock. Neither blocks the other.

identity.statement: Il software è uno strumento. Ogni linguaggio, schema e astrazione è scelto per il suo contributo misurabile a un obiettivo — mai per abitudine o gusto.

principles.title: Razionalità strumentale

principles.title: Flusso di controllo piatto
principles.body: Molte funzioni semplici, al massimo due livelli di annidamento, contratti espliciti tra loro.

timeline.title: Esecuzione dual-thread
timeline.subtitle: Due processi concorrenti che condividono un unico clock. Nessuno blocca l'altro.
